functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide access to 100% of the required information about services and applications for prospective applicants to make informed decisions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive information availability for research and selection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that all displayed information about services and applications is accurate and up-to-date with a refresh rate of no more than 24 hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and current information to aid decision-making.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load pages containing information about services and applications within 3 seconds for 95% of user requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring quick response times to maintain user engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a tutorial or help section that guides users through the research and selection process, accessible within two clicks from the main page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to navigate and understand the system, necessitating easy learning.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must allow users to filter and sort services and applications based on at least three criteria (e.g., type, relevance, popularity).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves selection, which should be facilitated by intuitive operability features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for research and selection 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the system for prospective applicants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user interactions with the research and selection interface using HTTPS.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user data, which requires protection during transmission.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the creation, editing, and formatting of staff reports with all necessary features (e.g., text editing, image insertion, data tables).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a complete set of tools for report development.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 200 MB of memory when processing and generating a staff report.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report generation, which should be efficient in resource usage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for report development, with drag-and-drop functionality for elements like images and tables.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires staff members to interact with the system, necessitating easy operability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must offer contextual help or tooltips for all report development features, accessible within one click.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves complex tasks, which should be supported by user assistance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must automatically save report drafts every 5 minutes and allow staff members to recover the last saved version in case of system failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves data entry, which should be safeguarded against loss.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that staff reports are not altered during transmission or storage, using checksums or digital signatures.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves the creation of reports, which must maintain integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for the addition of new report templates or modification of existing ones without affecting other system functionalities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report development, which may require updates and modifications.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must automatically redirect the user to the login page upon successful registration 100% of the time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a complete user journey from registration to login.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must complete the redirection to the login page within 1 second after successful registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user navigation, requiring quick response times.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The login page must have clear labels and instructions for entering credentials, with a maximum of three fields (username, password, submit).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the login page, necessitating clear operability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide real-time validation of entered credentials on the login page, with error messages displayed within 500 milliseconds of incorrect input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which should be protected against errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The login page must be available 99.99% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the login page for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user credentials using AES-256 encryption during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user data, which requires protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for user login to ensure the authenticity of the user.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user authentication, which should be secured with MFA.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that 100% of dataset instances of a type automatically use the new code upon deployment of a new version of the dataset type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires correct handling of dataset instances with new code.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must update dataset instances to use the new code within 1 minute of the new version deployment.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time updates, requiring timely processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle failures during the update process without affecting existing dataset instances, with a recovery mechanism in place.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical updates, which should be fault-tolerant.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must allow for rollback to the previous version of the dataset type if the new version causes issues, within 5 minutes of detection.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves version updates, which should be recoverable in case of problems.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure the integrity of dataset instances during and after the update process, using checksums or similar mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves data updates, which must maintain data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for the deployment of new dataset type versions without requiring downtime or affecting other system functionalities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves updates, which should be modifiable without system impact.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The system must support the addition of new dataset types without requiring changes to the existing codebase.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves dataset types, which may need to be adapted to new requirements.
